title: Time capsule
text: Write something to be opened on a future date. Until then nobody reads it, not even you.
bodyHint: What do you want to say to the future?
sharedText: Your partner reads it too when the date comes. Off, only you read it.
deleteText: It will be gone before anyone reads it. This cannot be undone.
emptyText: Write one and choose the day it opens.
errorText: Your capsules are still saved. Try again.

errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment.
errors(map).other: Couldn't save right now. Your text is still here.

deleteErrors(map).other: Couldn't delete this capsule. It's still here.
